preservedResponsibilities: Original res_load/res_unload default-package backend now uses only the complete native-exported raw graph for every982 top-level .res file, including zoneinfo64, langInfo and keyTypeData. The temporary legacy-root bridge is removed: public/raw reads share the same graph node and native pointer-group buffer identities, without a second resolved resource projection. Source raw aliases, exact table order, noFallback/pool flags, source status/reset/unload behavior and independent data handles are retained. The previous rich JSON exports remain native comparison/query fixtures only and have no runtime import.

The unchanged ICU78.3 uresbund.cpp public witness passes19888 queries: all982 direct package opens, all996 raw alias occurrences from root/keyTypeData, default/parent/root/direct and fill-in open modes, sticky failures, valid/actual identities, complete content digests, every initialized inline/path byte, long heap paths and the63-byte threshold, source alias-depth boundaries, scalar/iterator/copy state, same-handle/fill-in reuse and retained parent/pool references, plus756 actual ResourceDataValue data/valid-locale context cases. Source-valid narrow/count ranges and the pinned immutable default package are the certified projection; physical allocator/OOM/ABI/freed-pointer states and other packages remain uncertified.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed ICU APIs, external/named/non-top-level packages, user replacement data, physical struct layout/magic bytes, allocator/OOM/mutex/cleanup races, invalid/overlapping/freed pointers and version-allocation ownership remain uncertified. Complete Calendar service/formatter/CSV integration is still pending; foundation records do not claim it complete.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original large source is split by immutable package storage, filename fallback and mutable cached-entry ownership while preserving source algorithms and one data owner.
